thread:
maria: Originating RC for candidate 2026-03-20.rc1 — artifacts ready (sha: abcdef123). Requesting pin + smoke bake during change window tonight.

deploy-bot: Build created: artifact://redwood/2026-03-20.rc1 (sha: abcdef123)

maria: Approving pin request pending QA smoke pass. If QA OK, ping here and we'll trigger `promote`.

maria: QA green. @sam you can pin and promote when ready.

sam: Running pin now: `deploybot pin --artifact abcdef123 --env prod --by maria --until 2026-03-21T06:00:00Z`

sam: Pin successful. Promoting to prod in 2m.

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated: rc1 -> prod. Rolling small cohorts 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m.

nina: Noting release in product changelog (short blurb) and enabling observability dashboards for the metric set.

jon: Monitoring: first 10m looks good. No error spikes. Keeping sheriff on until tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

maria: Thanks all — marking RC origination and promotion complete. Leaving notes in the release docket. :tada:
